# snipeit_accessory (Resource)

Manages an accessory in Snipe-IT. `purchase_cost` is intentionally not supported (the API returns it locale-formatted, which does not round-trip stably).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_category" "keyboards" {
  name          = "Keyboards"
  category_type = "accessory"
}

resource "snipeit_accessory" "mx_keys" {
  name         = "Logitech MX Keys"
  qty          = 20
  category_id  = snipeit_category.keyboards.id
  model_number = "920-009415"
  min_amt      = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category (must be an `accessory` category).
- `name` (String) Name of the accessory.
- `qty` (Number) Total quantity of this accessory.

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the owning company.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `min_amt` (Number) Minimum quantity before a low-stock alert triggers.
- `model_number` (String) Manufacturer model number.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `order_number` (String) Order number of the purchase.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `supplier_id` (Number) Id of the supplier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the accessory.
